cases.name: accept-stale-revision
cases.defect: Approval checks that the revision is nonnegative instead of matching the submitted revision.

cases.name: accept-extension-control
cases.defect: The normal input handler accepts extension-origin enter and approval controls.

cases.name: replay-duplicate-approval
cases.defect: A repeated approval schedules the already-approved execution again.

cases.name: allow-custom-planning-tools
cases.defect: Planning preserves arbitrary previously active custom tools, using the same erroneous policy for dispatch and restore.

cases.name: replay-approved-resume
cases.defect: Restoring an approved session dispatches its persisted snapshot again despite the earlier execution.

cases.name: resume-original-toolset
cases.defect: Planning resume restores the original advertised tool set instead of the read-only subset; the ordinary dispatch guard is otherwise retained.

cases.name: drop-approved-request-context
cases.defect: The approved snapshot is saved correctly but is filtered out of the actual provider request.

cases.name: early-exit-zero
cases.defect: The extension terminates the candidate process with status zero before any behavior is exercised.

note: Expected failures require runtime confirmation; these checks prove patch application and syntax only.
